integrity: The included exact checks were executed against the standalone script; analytical almost-sure convergence is established by the written martingale proof, not by computation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to simple finite two-terminal networks of internally vertex-disjoint paths, every path length at least three, no cross-links, initial unit conductances and chronological forward loop erasure; no all-graph claim, no finite-n rate, and no independent audit. General urn results and inaccessible full thesis leave residual priority risk.
title: Sharp path-count laws for forward-loop-erased ants on parallel-route networks
